player_prompt.intro:
Wena uyinhloko {player_id} emdlalweni we-GameOfPureStrategy.
- Unaqhubekeza ikhadi ze-13 A-K; zingakwazi ukusetshenzwa zikhethekile.
- Kule round, ikhadi yebhajethi ibonakala. Dlala ikhadi eyodwa kabi ngokusho into esiyinhloko esithi [Q], [10], [2] ...
- Ikadi eliphakeme iyawina iphajethi (pplus ukuthunyelwa). Amaqhaza ahambisana ancula iphajethi kwi-poti yezuza yorondo.
- Iyiphi ingoma ephezulu inawina emuva kwemirondo ye-13.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lesento kumele sihlanganise likhadi LILINYE lelisemkhatsini.
